description: This is a source file for an Android app, specifically the MainActivity class that manages UI components, menu interactions, and logging setup within an Android project.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that sets up a fragment, handles menu options, and initializes logging for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the ClippingBasicFragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu layout for the activity.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures menu item properties dynamically based on the activity UI state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers and filters, and attaches a LogFragment for on-screen log display.
